name: Datadog
verdict: You need the Datadog Partner Network, a partner developer org and a Developer Platform listing. Production credentials are issued only when you submit for publication, and until then other orgs get invalid client errors; likely 4-8+ weeks.
needGuide: Yes — join the partner network and create a listing first; production credentials only come at submission.

auth.detail: OAuth 2.0 for integrations is available only to approved Technology Partners building official integrations, not standalone OAuth clients. Clients are confidential (secret shown once; one active secret). The flow must start from Datadog so the region 'domain' (for example ap1.datadoghq.com) and 'site' reach your onboarding URL; PKCE is supported. Refresh tokens do not expire unless revoked; access-token lifetime not confirmed. Request api_keys_write to mint an API key via /api/v2/api_keys/marketplace.

effort.timeToFirstTest: 1-2 days (partner org must be provisioned first)
effort.timeToProduction: unknown (likely 4-8+ weeks incl. partner onboarding and listing review)

approval.gate: Product must be generally available. Join the Datadog Partner Network, get a partner developer organization, create a Developer Platform listing, then submit for publication; production client credentials are issued only on submission. Until Datadog publishes it, the client works only inside your partner developer org (other orgs get invalid_request - Invalid client_id).

scopes.why: Request the minimum from Datadog's scopes reference; api_keys_write is needed to create the customer's API key.
scopes.summary: Request the minimum scopes from the Datadog scopes reference; api_keys_write is needed to create the customer API key. Send the access token as a Bearer token; using an application key with it causes Forbidden. Scope list not fetched.

cost: No fee stated in the pages read; partner program terms not verified.
prerequisites: Account and owner: A partner/alliances owner to apply to the Datadog Partner Network, plus an engineer with access to the partner developer organization and Developer Platform.

Where you register: Developer Platform → your listing → Configuration Method tab → API with OAuth → OAuth Client Name, Onboarding URL, Redirect URIs → Generate OAuth Client Secret → pick scopes → Save Changes
Cost: No fee stated in the pages read; partner program terms not verified.

registerAt.path: Developer Platform → your listing → Configuration Method tab → API with OAuth → OAuth Client Name, Onboarding URL, Redirect URIs → Generate OAuth Client Secret → pick scopes → Save Changes

steps.do: Apply to the Datadog Partner Network and obtain a partner developer organization (requires a GA product)
Create a Developer Platform listing and choose Configuration Method: API with OAuth
Enter OAuth client name, Onboarding URL and Redirect URIs, pick minimum scopes (plus api_keys_write if you submit data), generate and store the secret
Implement OAuth with PKCE, handle domain and site parameters, and call per-region API hosts without customer subdomains
Run Test Authorization in the partner org; confirm API key creation and data submission
Replace test URLs with production ones and submit the listing for publication to receive production credentials

roles.team: A partner/alliances owner to apply to the Datadog Partner Network, plus an engineer with access to the partner developer organization and Developer Platform.
roles.console: none documented for listing collaborators; secret rotation requires emailing ecosystems@datadog.com
roles.customer: A Datadog user at the customer starts the install from the integration tile and approves scopes; they likely need permissions to authorize apps and manage API keys (not confirmed). Customers choose their site/region.

testing: In your partner developer organization use Test Authorization on the OAuth config to simulate starting from the tile.
Testing and production use different client IDs and redirect URIs, so keep them in config.

blockers.fix: Non-partners cannot get an OAuth client; fallback is the customer pasting an API key plus application key (per task hint, not verified in these docs).
The test client only works in the partner org until published.
Update URLs when production credentials arrive.
Always use the domain parameter for API hosts.

automation.agentCan: Write the OAuth/PKCE flow, region handling and key-minting code, draft listing text and scope justifications, and run test calls.
automation.humanMust: Complete partner program enrollment and agreements, create the listing in the console, wait for Datadog publication, and email ecosystems@datadog.com to rotate secrets.

uncertain: Partner Network fees, review timeline and criteria, access-token lifetime and the full scope list were not confirmed; the OAuth2 endpoints reference failed to fetch (rate limit).
